howto: Type a name, pick a look and press Set Sail.
Walk with WASD or the arrow keys, or drag anywhere; tap a thing to walk to it and use it.
Pick a tool (1 to 6): net for bugs, rod for fish, shovel to dig, watering can, axe, slingshot.
Tap villagers for requests, sell finds at the shop and donate new ones to the museum.
tips: Shake fruit trees: fruit sells well and some requests ask for it.
Dig the sparkle spots ⭐ for fossils and treasure.
Plant in the soil by your house and water with 🚿 to grow twice as fast.
Pop balloons with the slingshot for presents.
A day lasts 8 minutes; crops keep growing while you are away.

controls.keyboard: WASD or arrows walk, Space or E acts, 1 to 6 pick tools, B opens the bag, T cycles tools. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Drag to walk, tap to walk to a thing and use it; the tool bar sits along the bottom.

difficulty: Cozy and self-paced: nothing can be lost. Requests grow in size as you go, the shop's better tools cost more, and the museum has four collections to fill.

cheats.effect: All tools: rod, axe and slingshot unlocked
Quick grow: every planted crop ripens now

features.autosave: The island saves on this device every 8 seconds and after every change (not while codes are on); the Journal can export and import a backup
features.goals-or-quests: Villager requests (catch, fish, dig, harvest, shake, decorate) with bells and furniture as rewards; the quest chip in the top bar shows progress
features.day-time-ui: Clock, day number, day/night and rain in the top bar; a Day summary card at the end of each day
features.inventory: The 🎒 bag (20 slots), furniture at home and the museum collections
features.results: The Day summary card (bells, bugs, fish, digs, harvests and vibe for the day) and the Islander's Journal
